action_instruction: Checking whether the header cart badge matches the visible cart item count
intent: whether the header cart-count badge matches the visible total item count in the cart lines

action_params.condition: the header cart-count badge reflects the visible total item count
action_params.query: whether the header cart-count badge matches the visible total item count in the cart lines
action_params.code_js: (() => { const badgeText = el(5)?.textContent || ''; const badgeCount = parseInt((badgeText.match(/\d+/) || [])[0] || '0', 10); const visibleCount = Array.from(el(7)?.querySelectorAll('.cart-line-qty') || []).reduce((sum, n) => sum + (parseInt((n.textContent || '').trim() || '0', 10) || 0), 0); return badgeCount === visibleCount; })()

action_instruction: Checking the cart products and quantities
intent: whether the cart contents show Trail Runner Sneakers with quantity 1

action_params.condition: the cart still shows the same products and quantities as before the reload
action_params.query: whether the cart contents show Trail Runner Sneakers with quantity 1
action_params.code_js: (() => { const lines = el(7).querySelectorAll('.cart-line'); if (lines.length !== 1) return false; const line = lines[0]; return line.querySelector('.cart-line-name')?.textContent.trim() === 'Trail Runner Sneakers' && Number(line.querySelector('.cart-line-qty')?.textContent.trim()) === 1; })()
